name: Engagement Curse
source:
After another failed engagement, you almost get robbed on the street, but a handsome stranger saves you. You wonder how you got eighteen men to propose to you yet never managed to get married. Your friends suggest going to the palm reader to see what she has to say about your love life...

[From in-app]
translation:
又一次订婚以失败告终后，你在街头险些遭到抢劫，幸好一位英俊的陌生人出手相救。你不禁纳闷：明明已有18个男人向你求过婚，为什么你却始终没能结成婚？朋友们建议你去找人看看手相，听听对方会如何解读你的感情生活……

[摘自应用内介绍]
